summary.conclusion: The frozen action producer matches key Section B timing and current-hot predicates, but the available sources do not support a claim of complete specification equivalence or original CG1AT-alpha replay.

items.finding: The comparison policy implements the 12+2k decision grid, exclusive 270s/290s stops, FAV current-hot [.55,.70] band, permanent F<=.40 stop, and UNDER current-hot >=.75/opposite-side selection. It emits 15-share ACTIVE intents at the side-owned ask price.

evidence.excerpt: 12+2k grid; FAV_STOP270 / UNDER_STOP290; current_mid thresholds; qty=15 and side-owned ask price

items.limitation: This pass is limited to the action predicates, not order-lifetime or whole-kernel parity.

items.finding: The policy sets F on the first valid call with age>=12000, rather than requiring a valid snapshot exactly at 12s. Invalid quotes return before F is initialized. If the 12s call is absent or invalid, a later grid call can anchor F to a later mid; the self-test only exercises the exact-12s case.
items.cohort_occurrence: UNKNOWN from the permitted source set; do not synthesize a 12s F for a market whose 12s quote is unavailable.

evidence.excerpt: invalid book returns; otherwise age>=12000 initializes self.fav
self-test calls exactly t=12000 and does not test a missing/invalid 12s frame
the loop begins at the first received-millisecond ceiling and advances at 1Hz

items.limitation: Code-level late-initialization behavior is established; whether a cohort market lacks a valid 12s frame is outside this source-only audit.
items.per_market_evidence_pointer: Main-agent B_PATH_VALIDITY artifact; not opened or used as evidence in this source-only audit.

items.finding: Section B uses fixed F only for the <=.40 permanent stop, while eligibility and purchase side use the current hot side. The frozen policy follows that distinction: fmid tracks initial F for the stop; current/current_mid select the band and side.

evidence.excerpt: F is defined at 12s; the band condition is the current hot mid; F has a separate <=.40 permanent stop
initial self.fav is stored and fmid drives the permanent stop
current side/current_mid drive the FAV band and emitted side

items.limitation: The separate exact-12s initialization limitation is recorded in FAV_INITIAL_SIDE_EXACT_12S.

items.finding: Section B states a holdings/share gate. The implementation defines owned as inventory plus pending remaining quantity and blocks at owned>=300. The producer calculates pending from nonterminal live carriers. This is stricter than a holdings-only gate whenever unfilled orders exist. The 15-share amount is not clipped to the remaining capacity, so the code should not be described as enforcing a hard post-trade maximum of 300.

evidence.excerpt: 且持股 < 300
owned = sum(inventory.values()) + sum(pending.values()); owned>=300 blocks
a passing intent still emits qty=15
pending is remaining quantity for live nonterminal carriers and is passed into intent()
self-test confirms inventory 290 plus pending 10 blocks

items.comparison_to_original_lab: The original strategy_lab also adds live unfilled quantity to shares before its <cap test (lines 45 and 52); that shared behavior does not make it holdings-only.

items.finding: The unchanged strategy_lab adds a second FAV gate: fixed initial-F mid must itself remain in [.55,.70], then the current-hot mid must also be in [.55,.70]. Section B and comparison_policy gate only on current-hot mid, while fixed F is used for the permanent <=.40 stop. After F softens below .55 but remains above .40, the frozen B policy may buy the opposite current-hot side while the original lab blocks. Do not describe the two FAV producers as identical.

evidence.excerpt: fixed fav/fm; fixed-F band at line 45; current side/current-mid band at lines 46-48
B specifies current-hot band plus the fixed-F permanent stop
B policy gates on current_mid and buys current side

items.causal_attribution: Not assigned; this identifies a rule difference, not an observed PnL cause.

items.finding: The B policy's UNDER condition uses current_hot_mid>=.75 and buys the opposite side; the original lab uses the same current-side threshold and opposite-side selection. Timing and cap/order-lifetime qualifications are audited separately.

UNDER_STOP290; current_mid<.75 blocks; opposite side emits 15

items.finding: Section B requires only-taker execution. The B policy emits route=ACTIVE; the stack wrapper creates an ACTIVE NEW and reserves ACTIVE while labeling its role TAKER. The original lab uses GTC LIMIT for non-passive taker orders. The allowed sources show marketable ask prices but no IOC/FOK or immediate-remainder-cancel enforcement. A TAKER role string and ACTIVE route do not establish a taker-only fill constraint.

evidence.excerpt: 只有吃單
route='ACTIVE'
NEW route ACTIVE; reserve ACTIVE; role label COMPARISON_FROZEN_TAKER
submit uses LIMIT with GTX only for passive; otherwise GTC
FAV/UNDER taker branches send the marketable side price with gtx=False

items.limitation: The report cannot certify complete compliance with the spec's only-taker requirement from these sources.

items.finding: The source uses GTC LIMIT for taker-labelled orders and tracks NEW/PARTIALLY_FILLED orders as live; taker orders have no general immediate-cancel rule shown. A GTC remainder may therefore remain eligible for later matching, but the permitted sources do not include the V49 active adapter or matching-engine implementation needed to determine whether that remainder can actually receive maker-classified fills.

items.limitation: Do not assert either that ACTIVE GTC did produce maker fills or that maker fills are impossible based on this source-only review.
